segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the 2026 renewal and the extra seats you mentioned for the Denver team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 74 seats today, and I need to add 12 more by February 3. Finance also asked me to keep the annual invoice under $58,000 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. With 86 seats on the standard plan, your renewal would be $55,040 for a 12-month term starting March 1. That includes the same support level you have now and the usage reports package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that works. Is that priced monthly or annual only?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Annual invoice, net 30, same as your current contract. If you need quarterly billing, it’s available, but the total would be $56,760.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, annual is fine. I’ll need the invoice dated after February 10 because our new PO opens then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. We can issue it on February 12 with the March 1 start date. For go-live on the 12 new seats, our onboarding team can run a 45-minute admin session the week of January 29.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s do January 30 at 11 Eastern if that’s open. Also, can the added seats access the compliance workspace on day one?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I’ll include that in the order notes and the confirmation email: 12 new users, compliance workspace enabled, admin session January 30 at 11 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the order form today, and I’ll route it with the PO request. If legal doesn’t touch the terms, we should have signature by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form with the $55,040 annual total, net 30, invoice date February 12, renewal term March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
